maya: Heads-uponboarding Salient-7B (community fork) into our eval pipeline. Conversion + int4 quant completed but we see a ~5.6% drop on our conv-QA suite vs fp16 baseline.
sam: flags/commands? link to the conversion artifacts? :mag:
maya: commands I ran:
```
python convert.py --input salient_fp16/ --output salient_sal/ --emit-tokenmap
python quantize.py --model salient_sal/ --format int4 --block=128 --calib-samples=2048 --preserve-emb=false
```
Convert logged: `WARNING: tokenizer mismatch: vocab sizes differ (50256 -> 50272) detected padding/sentinels`.
joel: that usually means token ids shifted; embeddings could be misaligned. Any tokenmap applied at load time?
maya: convert wrote tokenmap.csv and tokenmap.json but our runtime loader ignored tokenmap because the model metadata flagged same-vocab=true. So remap not applied to embedding/KV indices.
anya: also check rotary_scale: original model used 0.75 per config, convert defaulted to 1.0. That can change attention phases; quantization compounds it for long contexts.
sam: can you run quick experiments: 1) apply tokenmap remap, keep fp16 (no quant) 2) int4 quant + tokenmap remap 3) int4 quant + fp16 embedding table (hybrid) 4) int4 with rotary_scale forced to 0.75. keep eval batch=1.
maya: ran mini-sweep on staging (1000 QA examples):
```
1) remap, fp16: EM=93.8 (baseline fp16 95.0), p95 latency 115ms
2) remap + int4: EM=90.1, latency 52ms
3) int4 hybrid-emb(fp16): EM=92.6, latency 58ms
4) int4 rotary=0.75: EM=89.4, latency 52ms
```
joel: looks like tokenmap remap recovers most of the quality; hybrid-emb helps further. rotary adjustment alone isn't enough. so primary culprit is vocab->vector slot mismatch.
anya: FYI we previously saw similar shadowing on Vega-3B when padding tokens inserted during conversion. We should fail fast if tokenmap present but not applied.
sam: agreed. proposed fixes: - convert: if vocab_size mismatch && tokenmap exists -> require `--apply-tokenmap` flag or fail - quantizer: expose `--hybrid-emb` default false but warn strongly; provide `--preserve-emb-on-remap` auto-enable - runtime: when loading model with tokenmap, remap embedding and KV caches and add integration test to validate remap invariants
maya: opened PR with enforcement + test harness that samples 2k random token indices and verifies embedding lookup identity after remap. PR: https://rwd/pr/1288
infra-bot: salient-7b-int4 uploaded to staging. tag=salient-7b-int4-remap-2026-03-22
sam: can we schedule a long-context (2048) regression sweep overnight to ensure KV index continuity? we had misalignment after ~1k in a prior run.
maya: yes scheduled. I'll include the remap+hybrid-emb build for that run.
joel: also add a small diagnostic CLI `sample-token-shadow` that prints any token ids whose embedding slot changes after conversion. useful for support.
anya: and add a one-line release note: "Salient-7B: required tokenmap remap on conversion; int4 users recommended to enable hybrid embeddings to reduce QA regressions."
maya: thanks allwill post full longctx results tomorrow. :thumbsup:
